memory.title: Plan: #tags for pocket-notes
memory.body:
# Plan: #tags for pocket-notes

**Goal:** Add #tags to pocket-notes: parse them, filter with `notes list --tag`, and show a `notes tags` summary

## Approach
- Tags live in the note text (`#work`), so no storage migration: derive them on read.
- One parser (`src/tags.ts`) used everywhere: lowercase, de-duplicated, `-`/`_` allowed, `issue#12` is not a tag.
- CLI: `notes list --tag <t>` filter + `notes tags` summary.
- Output: tags in cyan when stdout is a terminal (respect NO_COLOR).

## Tasks
- t1 Explore repo & draft plan - Marlow
- t2 Tag parser module - Kit
- t3 `list --tag` + `tags` command - Juniper (after t2)
- t4 Highlight tags in output - Wren
- t5 Unicode & punctuation edge cases - Kit (after t2)
- t6 README + help text - Tove (after t3, t4)
- t7 Publish to npm - **blocked: needs Alex**
- t8 QA on main - Tove (after t5, t6)
- t9 Stretch: shell completion - Rowan

## Review
Rowan reviews every branch; then it goes to Alex as a merge decision. Nothing merges without Alex.
memory.author: marlow

memory.title: Repo conventions
memory.body:
# Repo conventions (pocket-notes)

- Node >= 22.18 runs the TypeScript sources directly (type stripping): no build step.
- Tests: `npm test` (node:test), files in `test/*.test.ts`. Keep the suite green before review.
- Zero runtime dependencies - keep it that way.
- Pure functions in `src/notes.ts`; I/O only in `src/cli.ts` and `src/store.ts`.
memory.author: marlow

memory.title: Decisions
memory.body:
# Decisions

- Tag colors use plain ANSI escapes, no chalk (install allowed, not needed).
memory.author: wren

memory.title: Regex notes
memory.body:
# Regex notes

- `/#(\w+)/` splits #to-do and matches issue#12. Use `(?:^|\s)#(\w[\w-]*)`.
- Unicode letters (#café) still need a look in t5.
